metadata.title: Send quote | Slashie
metadata.description: Send a clear quote for a Slashie task with price, message, and availability.

en.title: Send a quote
en.description: Share your price, timing, and why you are a good fit for this task.
en.notFoundDescription: This task may have been removed or is no longer available for quotes.
en.slotsInvalid: Add at least one time with a day and a start time in the future.
en.locationNote: Approximate area. The exact address is shared once a quote is accepted.

gate.signInBody: Sign in to send a quote for this task.
gate.workerProfileBody: Create your worker profile before you can send quotes.
gate.limitBody: You've used this month's free quotes. Quotes you've already sent stay editable.

metadata.title: 傳送報價 | Slashie
metadata.description: 為 Slashie 任務傳送清晰報價，包括價錢、訊息和可提供時間。

zh_hk.title: 傳送報價
zh_hk.description: 分享你的價錢、時間，以及為何適合這個任務。
zh_hk.notFoundDescription: 此任務可能已移除，或已不再接受報價。
zh_hk.slotsInvalid: 請最少加入一個時間，包括日期和未來的開始時間。
zh_hk.locationNote: 大約位置。報價被接受後才會提供確實地址。

gate.signInBody: 登入後即可為此任務傳送報價。
gate.workerProfileBody: 傳送報價前，請先建立你的工作者檔案。
gate.limitBody: 你已用完本月的免費報價。已傳送的報價仍可修改。
